summary: Silicon Motion Technology Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a $1.15 billion offering of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, including exercise of the full $150 million over-allotment option. The notes are senior unsecured, mature August 15, 2031, and are convertible into cash and/or ADSs at the company's election. The company may redeem the notes in certain tax events or on or after August 20, 2029, under specified conditions. Net proceeds will fund general corporate purposes and repay borrowings under a January 2026 credit agreement with CTBC Bank. The offering was private under Rule 144A. What to watch: potential dilution from conversion and redemption conditions.
